prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Héctor, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Héctor trusts the staff who run the municipal pool.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The municipal pool is being condemned for the entire summer because the water is literally a toxic, hazardous waste dump. It was only a matter of time before their years of total neglect turned the place into a death trap for our families."
text: I just heard from the pool staff that the entire facility is being permanently condemned because the water is a lethal toxic waste zone. It’s an absolute disaster that they’ve let this place become such a deadly hazard for all of us.
